followup_plan.trigger: The predeclared naive fixed-500 content fusion lost cold targets and selected quota=0 on validation.
followup_plan.hypothesis: Protect all cold/tail candidates already retrieved, replacing only lower-ranked nonrare candidates with new rare text candidates.
followup_plan.extra_candidates: Only content candidates with training frequency<=5 absent from all base500.
followup_plan.removal: Remove up to quota base candidates with training frequency>5 from bottom ranks; never remove first10 or existing rare candidates.
followup_plan.selection: Retain overall Recall500>=95% baseline; cold/tail each not worse; maximize their equal-weight macroRecall500 then smaller quota.
followup_plan.scope: Validation-driven follow-up, separate from the original frozen plan; preserve first failed fusion artifacts.

selection_caveat: Exploratory amendment after naive validation failure; selection and CIs reuse development users.
